newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close mixed.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Wednesday, as local investors failed to find a clear direction, traders said.
Prices ranged from 40 yen lower to 130 yen higher. The newly listed May 1998 contract ended at 16,400 yen per tonne, up by 10 yen from the opening. Volume was 34,807 lots.
Local investors generated light technical buying during the morning sesion, traders said. But the market had directionless trading until the afternoon session, they said.

On CBOT Project A, the spot May corn contract was traded at $3.03-1/4 bushel at 0750 GMT, up from $3.02-3/4 at Tuesday's close. Spot May CBOT soybean futures were traded at $8.38 per bushel on the overnight trading system, up from $8.36 at Tuesday's close.
